div.div:
① External User → Public DNS → cloudflared → Traefik → Public App
(e.g. app.mydomain.casa)
② Internal User → Internal DNS → Traefik → Public App
(e.g. app.mydomain.casa)
③ LAN/VPN User → Cilium Gateway → Internal App
(e.g. longhorn.mydomain.casa)

text.tspan: ① External User → Public DNS → cloudflared → Traefik → Public
② Internal User → Internal DNS → Traefik → Public App
③ LAN/VPN User → Cilium Gateway → Internal App

div.div:
✔ Traefik protects all public-facing apps at the edge.
✔ Cilium isolates sensitive apps (Longhorn, Firefly III) behind the LAN gateway.
✔ Vaultwarden (public) uses built-in auth + encryption.
✔ Firefly III requires a login and is only reachable from LAN/VPN.

div.div:
✔ All traffic uses legitimate HTTPS (browser-trusted).
✔ cert-manager handles automated certificate rotation.
✔ ExternalDNS manages DNS records automatically.
✔ Wildcard certificate (*.mydomain.casa) is shared by both gateways: one DNS challenge covers all services.

gateways: one DNS challenge covers all services.

✔ Secure, simple, and scalable for new internal services.
